freqLowMP.title: Low Cut Frequency
freqLowMP.description: This setting acts as a high-pass filter by blocking all frequencies below the specified value. It is typically used to eliminate unwanted low-frequency noise, such as rumble or structural vibrations, from your incoming signal.

freqHighMP.title: High Cut Frequency
freqHighMP.description: This setting acts as a low-pass filter by blocking all frequencies above the specified value. This helps clean up the data by removing high-frequency interference, electronic hiss, or noise outside your target range.

minAmpNormMP.title: Min Amplitude Norm
minAmpNormMP.description: This establishes the absolute minimum intensity threshold a signal must reach to be registered by the system. Any signal falling below this magnitude is discarded as background noise, which helps prevent false positive detections.
